2610.02781.title: OPD Before RL: Warm-Starting Rubric-Based RL with On-Policy Distillation
2610.02781.paper_summary: Many useful language-model tasks cannot be evaluated by exact outcome verification. Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) addresses this issue by scoring open-ended responses against explicit criteria. However, because the reward is assigned after the complete response, the training signal does not directly identify which individual decisions contributed to the final score. We propose a two-stage training framework that uses rubrics first as privileged teacher context for dense token-level supervision, then as rewards for further RL. In the first stage, rubric-privileged on-policy distillation (RP-OPD), a student without access to the rubric matches a rubric-aware teacher's next-token distributions at student-generated prefixes. In the second stage, RL directly optimizes the rubric reward and improves beyond the observed distillation plateau. We evaluate the framework on health and science tasks using open-weight models. Across HealthBench, ResearchQA, and RubricHub Science, we compare post-training methods and vary the amount of SFT or RP-OPD training before RL, finding that our two-stage framework achieves the highest scores among the methods evaluated. RP-OPD + RL shows limited signs of reward hacking on RubricHub Science, whereas the SFT + RL baseline increasingly receives high rewards for claims of rubric compliance without providing the required content. These findings support using rubrics to guide on-policy distillation before applying rubric-based RL.
2610.02781.paper_summary_zh: 許多有用的語言模型任務無法通過精確的結果驗證來評估。基於評分標準的強化學習（RL）通過根據明確標準對開放式回應進行評分來解決這個問題。然後，由於獎勵是在完整回應之後分配的，因此訓練信號並不能直接識別哪些個別決策對最終分數做出了貢獻。我們提出了一個兩階段的訓練框架，首先將評分標準用作密集的標記級別監督的特權教師上下文，然後作為進一步強化學習的獎勵。在第一階段，特權評分標準的在線蒸餾（RP-OPD），一個無法訪問評分標準的學生在學生生成的前綴上匹配一個了解評分標準的教師的下一個標記分佈。在第二階段，強化學習直接優化評分標準獎勵，並超越觀察到的蒸餾平臺。我們在健康和科學任務上評估該框架，使用開放權重模型。在HealthBench、ResearchQA和RubricHub Science中，我們比較了後訓練方法，並改變了在強化學習之前的SFT或RP-OPD訓練量，發現我們的兩階段框架在評估的方法中獲得了最高分數。RP-OPD + RL在RubricHub Science上顯示出有限的獎勵駭客跡象，而SFT + RL基線則越來越多地因聲稱符合評分標準而獲得高獎勵，而未提供所需內容。這些發現支持在應用基於評分標準的強化學習之前，使用評分標準來指導在線蒸餾。
